name: Savings Dai

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The three tracked deployments were reviewed separately. Ethereum sDAI 0x83f20f44975d03b1b09e64809b757c47f942beea is a verified non-proxy SavingsDai wrapper: at block 25535318 asset() and dai() returned DAI 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f, pot() returned 0x197e90f9fad81970ba7976f33cbd77088e5d7cf7, daiJoin() returned 0x9759a6ac90977b93b58547b4a71c78317f391a28, and both EIP-1967 slots were zero. Its source has no owner, role, pause, blacklist, gate, or arbitrary-holder-burn method; transfer/transferFrom are ordinary balance-and-allowance paths, and withdraw/redeem burn another holder's shares only with that holder's allowance. A zero-share transfer simulation returned true. Base 0x99ac4484e8a1dbd6a185380b3a811913ac884d87 and OP Mainnet 0x2218a117083f5b482b0bb821d27056ba9c04b1d3 are source-matched immutable OptimismMintableERC20 representations. At Base block 48648113 and OP block 154243398, each reported BRIDGE 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010 and REMOTE_TOKEN as Ethereum sDAI. Their mint/burn functions are onlyBridge: direct zero-amount burns from that bridge succeed for an arbitrary from address, while a non-bridge caller reverts. The current verified Base v1.1.0 and OP v1.13.2 L2StandardBridge implementations pass msg.sender as the withdrawal burn address, so current withdrawal paths burn only the caller's representation; zero-share transfer and withdrawal simulations succeeded. The free Base and OP endpoints rejected later fixed-block simulations as archive-only, but verified/matched code and the pinned bridge/token reads remain sufficient. The 2026-07-21 supply observation places 99.9015773187% of sDAI economic supply on immutable Ethereum sDAI and only 0.0984226812% on the two peripheral bridge representations. No current material deployment exposes a holder blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, or privileged burn path. sDAI retains upstream-only status through its tracked DAI parent rather than suppressing parent and reserve-side exposure with a direct override.

mintAuthority.summary: sDAI is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over DAI; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable DAI mint authority is inherited from reviewed Maker/Sky DAI.

controls.label: sDAI ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294731: asset() returned DAI 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F; name() returned 'Savings Dai'. EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0 (not upgradeable); owner() reverts (no owner). No privileged mint function — shares minted only on DAI deposit via ERC-4626 deposit/mint. Wrapper is immutable with no upgrade surface.

review.evidence: Refreshed 2026-07-20 from the verified Ethereum wrapper evidence: at block 25294731 sDAI is a non-upgradeable ERC-4626 wrapper (no proxy admin, no owner, and no privileged minter), with asset() = DAI. Shares mint only against deposited DAI, so local wrapper issuance is economically bounded; durable DAI mint authority remains inherited from dai-makerdao. No named prudential supervisor was established for the wrapper itself.

collateral: DAI deposited into the sDAI savings vault; the wrapper remains fully backed by DAI while the exchange rate compounds with the Dai Savings Rate
pegMechanism: Deposit DAI to mint sDAI and redeem sDAI for the current convertToAssets amount of DAI; the share price rises as DSR accrues, and Spark's savings front-end documents withdrawals without slippage or platform fees

oracleRisk.summary: sDAI is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over DAI and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required DAI parent carries the separately reviewed Sky Vault oracle, auction, backstop, and bad-debt branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: The sDAI contract is an ERC-4626 wrapper whose shares are minted against deposited DAI and redeemed back to DAI as the savings rate accrues. It does not originate borrower debt or liquidate collateral. The variantOf relationship preserves the complete DAI parent branch review.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum sDAI is the native ERC-4626 savings vault. The Base and OP Mainnet contracts are immutable OptimismMintableERC20 representations whose BRIDGE is the chain-local L2StandardBridge and whose REMOTE_TOKEN is Ethereum sDAI, so both routes use the canonical OP Stack lock/mint bridge rather than a Sky PSM or third-party bridge. A near-synchronous 2026-07-21 totalSupply snapshot attributes 144,534.700637683482349953 sDAI, or 0.0984226812% of canonical Ethereum supply, to the two bridge representations.

reserves.name: DAI savings vault shares

reserveReview.rationale: The reviewed wrapper contract identifies DAI as its underlying asset, and the Sky documentation describes sDAI as a DAI savings-rate wrapper. The direct reserve envelope is therefore one tracked DAI dependency; the inherited DAI backing and governance risks remain represented by the parent asset.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The wrapper review does not independently re-review the underlying DAI reserve and liquidation system.
